prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1378; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Conroe. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently receive mail.

A: I'd rather just keep to the accident itself, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine for now. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was pulling out of a parking space near the store entrance. The lot was fairly busy, and I was looking for a gap between cars.

Q: What direction were you traveling when the other vehicle made contact?

A: I was backing out slowly, maybe a few miles an hour. The other car came down the aisle from my right side and hit the rear passenger door.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I glanced over my left shoulder first, then my right, and by the time I looked again it was already there.

Q: Were there any witnesses, or did anyone speak to you at the scene?

A: A woman with a shopping cart stopped and asked if I was okay. I didn't get her details.

Q: Can you tell me about the injury you're claiming?

A: My right knee took the brunt of it. It hit the steering column when we stopped. It's been swollen and I've had trouble bending it, so I went to see a doctor a couple of days later.

Q: Have you had any prior problems with that knee?

A: I had some soreness years ago after a sports injury, but nothing that stopped me from working or driving.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get this resolved so I can get my knee treated properly.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
